notes.title: Quartet 1.1: Hard Mode (and more) Join the Party
notes.notes: [p]Once again, we'd like to thank everyone who's played and supported Quartet so far!  As always, if you're struggling or have feedback, post in the community forums- we [i]are[/i] keeping an eye on them (as you can hopefully see from this update)![/p][h1]New Features[/h1][p]While we've been hard at work over the past week, pushing fixes for bugs, crashes and softlocks, we've also been cooking up these new features:[/p][h2]Hard Mode[/h2][p]For players who enjoy the challenge, all enemies hit harder and faster; many enemies have enhanced movesets and more aggressive attack patterns.  Don't die![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/5fd1adcf87b944e4ad16310e31472f40613bf3c5.png"][/img][/p][h2]Airship Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Location Names[/b] have been added when pressing "select" on controller (or "1" on the keyboard) to show the zoomed in version of the world map, [/p][/*][*][p][b]Faster Movement [/b]- Turn and strafe faster.  The airship also takes off at a higher altitude[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clearer Landing Hints[/b] - When unable to land in areas for story areas, a bit of info is provided as to why or how to go around[/p][/*][/list][h2]Battle Turbo[/h2][p]A new config option speeds up battle animations and grinding with the rear right shoulder button on your controller,  configurable as either holding for turbo, or tapping to toggle on/off.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/a7aed3d0c645ed6ca60f58a1dd3133e682b59d39.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/663ec3322fa22dc61171974d93750cb148e13b11.png"][/img][/p][h2]Enemy Data [/h2][p]When targeting enemies with an attack, you will be reminded of whether an enemy is immune, weak, or resists the elements involved IF you've previously used an attack with that element (or used Zikaron's Clairvoyance skill)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/a90eeb50996ac3fb748b4dddd81f649b671823e4.png"][/img][/p][h2]Streamer Mode[/h2][p]Enabling this config option exports your party's front line as image sources for OBS (or your other preferred streaming software) to include in your overlay or background.  Can be configured to export their turn order icons, standing sprites or for the 8 main heroes, their concept art.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/f533cae426c4fb16b55151955fec572f9e8efb0a.png"][/img]Streamer Mode writes these images alongside your saved data, at the following locations:[/p][list][*][p]On Windows, Documents\\Something Classic\\Quartet\\[/p][/*][*][p]On Mac OS, ~/Library/Application Support/Something Classic/Quartet/[/p][/*][*][p]On Linux, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/unity3d/Something Classic/Quartet/ or $HOME/.config/unity3d/Something Classic/Quartet/[/p][/*][/list][p]If you need to customize the assets, or want to use the source assets in your overlay in some other way, they can be accessed from your Steam Library > Properties > Installed Files > Browse ... > Quartet_Data > StreamingAssets > Portraits.[/p][h2]Oxford Comma Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]The description of the Oxford comma in the config menu now includes an Oxford comma.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/54df8659fa3cabc732c1d345b05170ece417e43f.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]We've identified 8 additional locations in the script where Oxford commas were (or weren't!) being used correctly (or not!)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed some typos, collision issues, and airship softlocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved support for non-Xbox gamepads and touchpads.[/p][/*][*][p]Healing animations in the menus play a bit faster.[/p][/*][*][p]HD Font support is no longer "Experimental",[/p][/*][*][p]Various improvements to player animation speed and quality,[/p][/*][*][p]The special move [b]Onslaught [/b]now does \[Slash] damage instead of \[Pierce][/p][/*][*][p]Alexandra's Weapons all bestow 1 more point of MAG[/p][/*][*][p]Other miscellaneous bugfixes and improvements,[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for your continued support!  And as always, if you are enjoying the game, or appreciate how we're supporting it, post in the forums or shoot us a review on Steam. [/p]

notes.title: Kickstarter Alpha Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
You may have noticed that we missed our monthly update in October. We were hoping to have our next update be a big one, and unfortunately we were not ready to announce. But we've made it in just the nick of time. So here goes: [b]The first four chapters of Quartet are now available in an alpha build.[/b] If you are a backer, you can play them right now!

For instructions on how to play the first four character chapters, please view our Backer-only post over on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0/posts/3919241]Kickstarter[/url]

(If you are not a Kickstarter backer, you can still play the public Quartet demo on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1307960/Quartet/]Steam[/url])

Each chapter is an introduction to two characters. In [b]Cordelia’s chapter[/b], she is wrongfully implicated by a political scandal, and loses her position in the government. She decides to go out west—well, technically east—and lay down the law. Taking the mantle of sheriff, she tries to make a name for herself so that she can return to the capital in undeniable triumph. She happens upon Jerome, and then things take a very unexpected turn… for the worse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/8d90aec567f9d5e41808b31414c77b9ebbd5936f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/aa26a65fb1c2ee5513d5c95e987dadaa4cee4cd5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/c64165d295eef77d2c72d27f2296aef07381df6a.jpg[/img]

[b]In Ben’s chapter[/b], he suddenly acquires magical powers, relatively late in life. Cool, right? Well, not if you accidentally blow up the restaurant you work at. Then you’re gonna be hard to employ, and rent is still due on the first of the month. A few people are willing to pay for his magical services. One of them is Agata, a “Phylaka,” whose job it is to monitor mages in Ben’s hometown. Slowly, we learn more about Agata and Ben, and what his powers might mean for his future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/7e6406cd562d582f3e2761b448da273fa374bdf6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/c1a42746a3dafcb410bfb301d5d14f077c9a3c95.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/ca9ac57f8e252b1e84dd18752fde92eb809f9631.jpg[/img]

[b]In Nikolai’s chapter[/b], he has just been promoted to staff sergeant, and placed in command of a squad of the glorious Seventh Border Guards. After roaming the wilds in pursuit of a barbarian raider, he watches as war breaks out between his country and their powerful neighbor. This shakes up his life, as wars often do. Soon, he and his squad find themselves ordered to perform highly questionable tasks in the subjugated city of Stral.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/e0aa9c5db15a6ebd951aad85d8788dafad6505e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/10dadb58561d6898e1b8de7c43097eac17805ef9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/11e2bfd269abad87753704d88f674d4712d583e3.jpg[/img]

[b]In Alexandra’s chapter[/b], a personal tragedy leaves her family hurting—and her family business hurting even worse. Struggling to pay her bills, she turns to her brother Alvin, a small-time gangster. This decision plunges her into far more trouble than she imagined, when suddenly she is being pursued by other criminals, the police, and even a mysterious ghost. Is she simply destined for sorrow and stress? Or does the mysterious deck of magical cards she found hold the key to her future?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/e0aa9c5db15a6ebd951aad85d8788dafad6505e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/3f82f566582d9bf1fb3115b511a737ce1776f744.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/a5f83c9a45a82406a6ded1d00ad409cc0c93e9f5.jpg[/img]

That should about cover it - I hope you all enjoy playing the demo! As always, wishlisting the game is the best way to support us now. Because of your support, our Steam wishlists are approaching 14k!! So please, continue to spread the word to friends about our game! Our game can only succeed with the help of all of you. 

Also, we will be presenting a booth at [url=https://super.magfest.org/]MagFest [/url]again in Jan 2024. Please come by and say hi!

If you want to stay in touch, please join us on our [url=http://www.discord.gg/somethingclassic]discord[/url], follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SomethingClassc]twitter[/url]. Have a great day!

notes.title: QUARTET ARRIVES TO KICKSTARTER
notes.notes:
[h1]QUARTET ARRIVES TO KICKSTARTER[/h1]
[h2]Classic turn-based indie RPG with tag-team mechanics[/h2]

[b]September 1st, 2021:[/b] Quartet, the second retro-inspired JRPG from games studio Something Classic, is live on Kickstarter now until September 30th, 2021.  A spiritual successor to Something Classic’s 2017 release, Shadows of Adam, Quartet lets players control eight characters across four stories that gradually merge into one epic quest.  Backers on Kickstarter can opt into a variety of rewards, from copies of the game to higher-level rewards like the chance to design epic gear, craft an NPC, or even write a whole quest!  Join the campaign: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0[/url]

[i]“Shadows of Adam was a success for us,”[/i] says producer Tyler Mire.  [i]“But we learned so much from the experience and the user feedback. We’ve put everything we’ve learned into Quartet to make it so much bigger and better than our last game.”[/i]

From the steampunk-inspired streets of Leornia, to the airship battles that rage on the battlefront of the Auslen Empire, Quartet takes players on an adventure they will never forget!  Meet a remarkable cast of characters including a snooty mage, a disillusioned soldier, an irreverent cook, a troubled shop girl, a sentient water mammal, a dashing doctor, a magical cop, and an ancient golem.  Collect oodles of powerful gear for your small army of protagonists, while unraveling an ancient conspiracy that literally reshaped the world centuries ago.

[b]Features include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Eight heroes with a unique roster of spells and abilities
[*] Tactically deep tag-team combat
[*] A sprawling, character-driven story
[*] Tons of epic and imaginative loot
[/list]


[b]ABOUT QUARTET[/b]
Quartet begins with four separate chapters, playable in any order.  In those four chapters, players meet eight unlikely heroes, and get to see how the stories intertwine into an epic narrative surrounding the war over the control of magic.  In battle, players deploy four characters at any time, with the ability to instantly swap the other four characters in, tag-team style.

[b]ABOUT SOMETHING CLASSIC[/b]
Something Classic is an indie studio with a passion for modern takes on the classic JRPG genre.  Their previous game, Shadows of Adam, was a cult hit among retro JRPG enthusiasts and is available on Steam, Nintendo Switch and Sony Playstation 4.

Quartet is on Kickstarter from September 1st 2021 through September 30th 2021 at [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/somethingclassic/quartet-0[/url]

[url=https://press.somethingclassic.net/sheet.php?p=quartet]PRESS KIT[/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/eba27e05674c19aae545764798780e9c82489fe5.png[/img]
